packages.name: tlbgen
packages.description:
Tlbexport and (Delphi) Tlbimport for post build events

example for delphi pas gen:

SET TLB_EXP="$(SolutionDir)\packages\tlbgen.1.0.0\tools\tlbexp.exe"
SET TLB_IMP="$(SolutionDir)\packages\tlbgen.1.0.0\tools\tlibimp.exe"
SET OUTPUT_TLB="$(TargetDir)$(TargetName).TLB"
SET OUTPUT_PAS="$(TargetName)_COM_TLB"
CALL SET OUTPUT_PAS=%%OUTPUT_PAS:.=_%%.pas


%TLB_EXP% "$(TargetPath)" /out: %OUTPUT_TLB%
%TLB_IMP% %OUTPUT_TLB% -p -d"$(SolutionDir)\DelphiCOM\" -Ft%OUTPUT_PAS%
